summary: Cameco filed a 6-K attaching a September 30, 2026 news release acknowledging a US–Korea Framework under a prior MOU for up to US$120 billion of Korean investment in Westinghouse reactor buildout. The framework contemplates eight US reactors—six Westinghouse AP1000s and up to two Korean APR1400s—plus a possible Korean equity investment in Westinghouse; Cameco expects no change to its Westinghouse ownership. Compensation may total roughly US$2 billion per APR1400 via licensing, services and fuel supply. Deal is non-binding and subject to definitive agreements, sites, financing and regulatory approvals.
